items.title: Suspected bomb threat hoaxes prompt evacuation of Italian schools, alarm in UK and Ireland
items.brief: Hundreds of schools across Italy were evacuated on Wednesday after bomb threats were sent to about 6,300 institutions, becoming the latest in a series of incidents targeting infrastructure across Europe.

items.title: Russian ambassador to US dies, foreign ministry says
items.brief: Russia’s ambassador to the United States, Alexander Darchiev, has died aged 66, the Russian Foreign Ministry said on Wednesday.

items.title: Ted Turner’s American views can be yours
items.brief: A slew of paintings that once belonged to Ted Turner will go on sale in January.

items.title: Peruvian homecoming: Pope Leo returns to the country that shaped his path to the papacy
items.brief: Riding on horseback to visit the most isolated Andean areas of his community, distributing food amid the Covid-19 pandemic, or wearing rubber boots in the water and mud of floods: this is how many Peruvians remember…

items.title: See which 11 Democrats missed the Pete Hegseth impeachment vote
items.brief: The House of Representatives voted on Tuesday evening to send an effort to impeach Pete Hegseth to committee, effectively killing the movement to oust the defense secretary before the end of the year.

items.title: Man accused of raping three women in New York’s Central Park is arrested in Miami Beach
items.brief: A man accused of raping three women in New York’s Central Park over the span of five years has been arrested in Florida, police announced Tuesday.

items.title: At least 3 people dead after vehicle strikes pedestrians in North Hollywood, officials say
items.brief: At least three people are dead and two others are injured after an SUV crashed into a group of street vendors and pedestrians near a Metro entrance in the North Hollywood neighborhood of Los Angeles, officials said…

items.title: Kennedy family sues to block Trump’s arch
items.brief: One of America’s most storied political dynasties — the Kennedy family — is suing the Trump administration to block construction of the president’s 250-foot triumphal arch .
